### Headline summary
- CISA warns federal agencies that a critical Cisco Expressway vulnerability is being actively exploited in the wild. ([BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/cisa-flags-critical-cisco-expressway-rce-flaw-as-actively-exploited/), [Infosecurity Magazine](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/critical-cisco-expressway-flaw/))
- CrowdStrike has agreed to acquire Zscaler in a $43.9 billion deal, projecting the combined entity will exceed $10 billion in annual recurring revenue. ([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/crowdstrike-to-acquire-zscaler-in-43-9-billion-deal/), [Help Net Security](https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/11/23/crowdstrike-zscaler-43-9-billion-acquisition/))
- Cleverbridge confirmed a data breach where hackers stole customer payment card numbers and CVV codes from its e-commerce platform. ([Infosecurity Magazine](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/cleverbridge-payment-card-breached/), [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/203851/data-breach/cleverbridge-confirms-attackers-copied-payment-card-data-from-its-platform.html), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/cleverbridge-data-breach/), [Help Net Security](https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/11/23/cleverbridge-data-breach-card-numbers-cvv/))

### CISA flags critical Cisco RCE flaw as actively exploited in attacks
The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) warned federal agencies that attackers are now exploiting a recently patched critical Cisco Expressway vulnerability in the wild. ([BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/cisa-flags-critical-cisco-expressway-rce-flaw-as-actively-exploited/), [Infosecurity Magazine](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/critical-cisco-expressway-flaw/), [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/sap-netweaver-cisco-expressway-flaws-exploited-in-attacks/))

### CrowdStrike to Acquire Zscaler in $43.9 Billion Deal
CrowdStrike expects the combined company to have more than $10 billion in annual recurring revenue. ([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/crowdstrike-to-acquire-zscaler-in-43-9-billion-deal/), [Help Net Security](https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/11/23/crowdstrike-zscaler-43-9-billion-acquisition/), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/crowdstrike-acquire-zscaler/), [Infosecurity Magazine](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/crowdstrike-to-acquire-zscaler/))

### Cleverbridge Confirms Customers’ Payment Card Data Breached
The stolen information reportedly includes card numbers and security codes stored by Cleverbridge, putting affected individuals at immediate risk of fraud ([Infosecurity Magazine](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/cleverbridge-payment-card-breached/), [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/203851/data-breach/cleverbridge-confirms-attackers-copied-payment-card-data-from-its-platform.html))

### Cleverbridge Confirms Hackers Stole Customer Card Numbers and CVV Codes in a Major Data Breach
Cleverbridge confirmed that hackers copied payment card data from its e-commerce platform. The stolen information includes card numbers, expiration dates, and CVV or CVC security codes. ([Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/cleverbridge-data-breach/), [Help Net Security](https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/11/23/cleverbridge-data-breach-card-numbers-cvv/))

### Microsoft Azure flaw exploited to steal customers' API credentials
Microsoft is warning customers that a security vulnerability in Azure API Management (APIM) Classic tiers was exploited to steal stored API credentials, with Norwegian authorities linking the flaw to cyberattacks against energy companies. ([BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/microsoft-azure-flaw-exploited-to-steal-customers-api-credentials/))

### FBI reportedly facing second data breach involving National Crime Information Center
The FBI is reportedly investigating a data breach involving the National Crime Information Center, a database used by U.S. law enforcement agencies that contains information on criminals, fugitives and missing people. ([The Record](https://therecord.media/fbi-cyberattack-data-breach))

### Spanish LaLiga confirms hackers stole soccer fans’ personal data
LaLiga, Spain's top men's football league, disclosed a data breach that exposed personal information belonging to users of its services and those of some affiliated clubs. ([BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/spanish-laliga-confirms-hackers-stole-soccer-fans-personal-data/))

### GlobeTopper loses $2.5 million after hackers steal $70k in gift cards
A cyberattack disrupted operations at B2B top-up solutions provider GlobeTopper, causing an estimated $2.5 million in lost revenue, while the attacker redeemed digital gift cards worth $70,000. ([BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/globetopper-loses-25-million-after-hackers-steal-70k-in-gift-cards/))
